name: baton
description: Baton is a Claude Code plugin: a task logbook kept by hooks, one folder per task. A session opens on the board of whose move it is, a Stop hook hands back a turn that leaves work unrecorded, after compaction the entry is written first, and the next session reads it: a session handoff in plain Markdown. Hooks run in Claude Code (terminal, IDE, desktop Code tab); in claude.ai chat only the skills load. The hooks make no network requests; review tools run by hand send text to OpenRouter.

tasks_folder.title: Task folder
tasks_folder.description: Where your task folders live: one folder per task, each with its logbook. Created at the first session if it is missing. The agent writes the logbook entries; the hooks read the folders and keep a few files of their own there: the conversation since the last entry (.baton-chat/), the task numbers (.baton-ids.json) and a note of what was sent off this machine (.baton-outside.md).

logbook.title: Logbook file name
logbook.description: The file in each task folder that holds its record, newest entry first. Use a word in your own language if you prefer.
